Brown Butter Blondies

Chewy bars with crackly tops. You'll need an 8×8 inch baking pan and an oven at 350°F.

  • Line the pan so the bars lift out in one piece.
  • A 9×9 inch pan works for thinner bars.

Brown Butter Blondies

Ingredients

  • 1 1/4 cups light brown sugar*
  • 1 cup all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup cornstarch, sifted
  • 1/3 cup powdered sugar, sifted
  • 2/3 cup white chocolate chips
  • 1/2 teaspoon flaky salt
  • 2 large eggs
  • 1/2 cup melted butter or coconut oil**
  • 3 tablespoons milk
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla

Instructions

  • Preheat the oven to 350°F. Butter an 8x8 baking tin (a 9x9 tin gives thinner bars) and line it with parchment.
  • Mix the sugar, flour, cornstarch, powdered sugar, chocolate chips and salt in a bowl.
  • In a second bowl, beat the eggs with the butter, milk and vanilla.
  • Fold the dry mix into the wet mix until no streaks remain.
  • Spread the batter in the tin and bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until the edges are golden. Cool before slicing.
